iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 5 evening assessment: AP/IAEA says inspectors still cannot access struck Iranian atomic facilities and cannot verify enrichment activity, stockpile size, composition, or whereabouts; Reuters reports US intelligence sees limited new damage while IAEA cannot verify about 440 kg at 60%. Nuclear issue remains blocked behind rejected Hormuz-first diplomacy. Probability 62%. Rising/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Reuters confirms the rejected Hormuz-first proposal and continued blockade impasse; Reuters energy coverage keeps crude above $100 with limited Strait traffic; Guardian reports Project Freedom, Trump threats against Iranian attacks on US vessels, and US claims of sinking six Iranian small boats. Direct US-Iran maritime contact remains acute. Probability 89%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Al Jazeera/AFP reports Israel issued new forced displacement orders covering more than 10 southern Lebanon towns, including areas north of the Litani, followed by strikes. Ceasefire exists only in name; operational area expanding. Probability 85%. Rising/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Turkey search remains dominated by mediation and internal Kurdish peace-effort coverage, including Erdogan efforts to revive Russia-Ukraine negotiations. No fresh Turkish kinetic trigger found. Probability 13%. Falling/elevated.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Search results are stale 2025 Kashmir crisis retrospectives rather than fresh 2026 contact. No fresh mobilization or cross-border strike signal found. Probability 7%. Stable/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Search shows residual NATO criticism of Russian and Chinese atomic posture and background rhetoric, but no new alert posture shift or direct NATO-Russia trigger. Coupling from Ukraine deep strikes sustains critical rating. Probability 36%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China
china.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Reuters China-Taiwan results remain centered on April military activity, Beijing calling activities justified, and rejection of US pressure claims. No fresh blockade or live-fire escalation in latest search. Probability 50%. Falling/imminent.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Search surfaces April 19 ballistic activity and low-quality reposts, but no confirmed fresh DPRK launch or atomic detonation event in the current window. Technical signal decays. Probability 31%. Falling/critical.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Al Jazeera and BBC report Ukraine expanding long-range strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, including Perm/Urals targets about 1,500-1,600 km from front; Kremlin labels attacks terrorism and reduces Victory Day parade exposure. Short ceasefire proposal remains contested. Probability 64%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 5 evening assessment: Al Jazeera reports Afghanistan accused Pakistan of a cross-border attack in Kunar killing three civilians and wounding 14, calling it a war crime; Pakistan denied it. The incident strains the April China-brokered ceasefire after months of clashes. Probability 29%. Rising/critical.
